name: tapstory
description: TapStory: NFC photo cards with family voice messages (Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2)

scripts.dev: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply tapstory-db --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply tapstory-db --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json
